benefits.mechanism: Glabridin, licorice’s key polyphenol, slows tyrosinase-driven melanin production, so pigment builds up less over time.
benefits.what_it_means: Gently brightens and evens the look of tone and dark spots with gradual use.

benefits.mechanism: Licorice flavonoids scavenge oxidative stress at the skin surface.
benefits.what_it_means: Adds antioxidant support and helps calm the look of redness.

evidence.summary: Glabridin-driven tone-evening and antioxidant activity is an established cosmetic function of licorice extract; graded C (ingredient function).

overview: Licorice root extract gently brightens and evens tone through its glabridin content while adding antioxidant support — a mild, well-tolerated tone ingredient.

ingredient.what_it_is: An extract of licorice root whose signature compound, glabridin, is a well-known gentle brightening and antioxidant agent.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: It gently evens tone by slowing pigment production; it does not whiten or bleach, and works gradually.
